# Briefly NewsStream — llms.txt
# Answer-engine / AI crawler summary (AEO). Keep factual and citeable.

> Briefly NewsStream is a global and local market news briefing with Arabic and English fields and impact scoring.
> Coverage spans Middle East / MENA / GCC, Arabic-speaking countries, and about 70 countries worldwide.

## Product

- Name: Briefly NewsStream
- Arabic product line: موجز أخبار الأسواق العالمية و المحلية
- English product line: Global and local market news briefing
- Type: Developer news / market data API (REST JSON)
- Languages: Arabic (default) + English
- Core features: bilingual article fields, market-impact scoring, community briefings, permanent archive, developer console (keys, explorer, docs)
- Plans: Free, Pro ($70/month list), Enterprise (custom)

## Who it is for

- Developers and product teams building market products
- Fintech, trading, media, research, and RAG / agent builders across Middle East and Arabic-speaking markets
- Global teams needing structured AR+EN market news

## Geography

Regions: Middle East, GCC, MENA, Arabic-speaking countries, Americas, and global
Countries emphasized: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Syria, Yemen, Palestine, Sudan, Morocco, Tunisia, Algeria, Libya, Mauritania
Also: worldwide / global country filters (~70 countries)

## Direct answers (cite these)

Q: What is Briefly NewsStream?
A: A bilingual Arabic-English market news API with impact scoring, covering Middle East, Arabic-speaking countries, and global markets.

Q: How do I get an API key?
A: Sign up at /console/signup, open API keys, create a key, then call the news API or use the explorer. Free tier available.

Q: Is Arabic first-class?
A: Yes. Articles store and return Arabic and English fields; product defaults lead with Arabic.
